meta.formula: ending = principal × (1 + APY/100)^years ; interest = ending − principal
meta.assumption: APY held constant for the whole horizon described in each cell. All rates compared here are variable except none — no CD is included — so the bank may change the rate at any time before or after opening. Projections are arithmetic illustrations, not bank quotes or guarantees.

rows.label: Chase — Chase Savings℠
rows.note: The official rate page states 'In order to see rates table, please provide valid 5-digit zip code.' No rate is rendered to an automated fetch, and adding ?zipCode=10001 / ?zip=10001 did not render it. Rate deliberately left blank.

rows.label: Citibank — Citi® Savings (and Citi® Accelerate Savings)

rows.label: TD Bank — TD Simple Savings (and TD Signature Savings)
rows.note: The rates page prints the disclosure 'APY is accurate as of 10/21/2026' but the tier table itself renders empty in an automated fetch (the location selector has no default region). No value is shown.
